name: Thực tập tại trợ toàn bộ viện Max Planck Đức (Max Planck Research Internship)
organization: Max Planck Institutes for Informatics, Software Systems, and Security and Privacy
funding: Tất cả các thực tập sinh được nhận là được hưởng trợ cấp, và chi phí ăn ở cũng như chi phí đi lại từ nơi cư trú đến viện.
academicRequirements: Chương trình thực tập được mở cho sinh viên Cử nhân, Thạc sĩ và Tiến sĩ xuất sắc trên toàn thế giới, cũng như những cá nhân xuất sắc quan tâm đến việc tích lũy kinh nghiệm nghiên cứu học thuật về khoa học máy tính.

other: Làm việc trong môi trường làm việc tiếng Anh

otherRequirements: Các thực tập sinh thành công thường được đồng tác giả các bài báo được công bố tại các hội nghị học thuật hàng đầu.
description: Research internship program in Germany for Computer Science students at Bachelor, Master, and PhD levels. It provides a stipend and covers accommodation and travel expenses while working with leading professors.

name: Chương trình Thực tập cho khu vực Châu Á và Thái Bình Dương (RAP) - Tổ chức Nông Lương Liên Hợp Quốc (FAO)
organization: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations (FAO)
funding: FAO cung cấp trợ cấp hàng tháng cho thực tập sinh nếu họ không được tài trợ bởi các trường đại học hoặc tổ chức khác.
academicRequirements: Đang theo học hoặc vừa tốt nghiệp chương trình đại học hoặc sau đại học tại một cơ sở giáo dục “chính thức” tại thời điểm nộp đơn. Lưu ý rằng FAO chỉ chấp nhận các bằng cấp cao học từ các cơ sở được công nhận/được cấp phép trong Cơ sở dữ liệu Giáo dục Đại học Thế giới (WHED). Ứng viên phải chuyên ngành trong một lĩnh vực liên quan đến nhiệm vụ và công việc của FAO.

other: Có khả năng sử dụng ít nhất một ngôn ngữ của FAO (Tiếng Ả Rập, Tiếng Trung, Tiếng Anh, Tiếng Pháp, Tiếng Nga, Tiếng Tây Ban Nha). Biết thêm một ngôn ngữ của FAO sẽ là một lợi thế.

otherRequirements: Là công dân của các quốc gia thành viên FAO. Ứng viên phải từ 21 đến 30 tuổi. Ứng viên cần có khả năng thích ứng với môi trường quốc tế đa văn hóa và có kỹ năng giao tiếp tốt. Các ứng viên đã từng thực tập tại FAO sẽ không đủ điều kiện tham gia thực tập lần nữa. Các ứng viên đã được chọn phải có tình trạng cư trú hoặc visa hợp lệ tại quốc gia dự định công tác trước khi gia nhập tổ chức. Các ứng viên có người thân (bao gồm mẹ, cha, chị em, anh em ruột) làm việc tại FAO dưới bất kỳ hình thức hợp đồng nào sẽ không đủ điều kiện tham gia chương trình thực tập.
description: Internship opportunity with the FAO for students and recent graduates to contribute to sustainable development goals. It offers practical work experience in fields related to food security and agriculture with a monthly stipend.

name: HỌC BỔNG HUAYU ENRICHMENT – KHÓA HỌC TIẾNG NGẮN HẠN TỪ BỘ GIÁO DỤC ĐÀI LOAN
funding: khoản trợ cấp hàng tháng trị giá 25.000 Đài tệ (khoảng gần 20 triệu tiền Việt Nam)
academicRequirements: Đối tượng học: Sinh viên quốc tế
otherRequirements: Thời gian học: 02, 03, 06, 09 tháng học tiếng. Nhằm tăng hiểu biết về văn hóa và xã hội Đài Loan, và thúc đẩy sự hiểu biết và tương tác lẫn nhau giữa Đài Loan và cộng đồng quốc tế.
description: A short-term Mandarin Chinese language scholarship provided by the Taiwanese Ministry of Education for international students. Recipients receive a monthly stipend of 25,000 TWD for durations ranging from 2 to 9 months.

name: Science International Scholarships (University of Queensland)
academicRequirements: Have a conditional or unconditional offer for a relevant program. For undergraduate students, have completed year 12 (or equivalent) in the last two years. For postgraduate students, have completed your most recent degree in the last two years.

other: The source page does not specify language scores for this scholarship; standard university entry requirements apply.

otherRequirements: Be an international student. You must be enrolling in your first year of an eligible program at the University of Queensland. You must not have already completed a degree in Australia.
description: These scholarships are offered to high-achieving international students seeking to study undergraduate or postgraduate programs within the Faculty of Science. It provides a single payment to assist with initial study costs.

name: UWA Global Excellence Scholarship
funding: Up to AUD 48,000 over 4 years (or AUD 12,000 per year)
academicRequirements: Have an ATAR of 85.00 – 98.00+; or WAM of 65.00 – 85.00+. Must be applying for an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree.

other: Verification of English language proficiency as per UWA standard admission policy.

otherRequirements: Be an international student. Be a citizen of one of the eligible countries (listed on the UWA website). Have received an offer for an undergraduate or postgraduate course at The University of Western Australia.
description: This is a high-value scholarship aimed at high-achieving undergraduate and postgraduate students from selected countries. The award is applied as a fee reduction across the duration of the course.

name: Destination Australia Scholarship
academicRequirements: Applicants must meet the academic entry requirements for their chosen course of study at the University.

other: Standard University English language proficiency requirements apply.

otherRequirements: Be an international student on a valid student visa. Study full-time at a regional campus (e.g., Casuarina or Katherine for agriculture). Maintain ongoing residency in a regional area for the duration of the scholarship.
description: Funded by the Australian Government, this scholarship encourages international students to study in regional Australia. It provides significant financial support for those enrolled in agriculture and environmental programs at regional campuses.

name: Engineering and Computer Science Graduate Entrance Scholarship
academicRequirements: Applicants must have a high academic standing in their previous undergraduate or graduate studies. Candidates are typically expected to have a minimum GPA equivalent to 3.70/4.30.

other: English language proficiency must be demonstrated if the previous degree was not completed in English.

otherRequirements: The scholarship is available to international students entering a research-based Master’s (MASc) or Doctoral (PhD) program in the Gina Cody School of Engineering and Computer Science. No separate application is required; students are automatically considered based on their admission application.
description: This entrance scholarship is designed to attract top-tier international graduate students to Concordia University's engineering and computer science programs. It provides a significant one-time financial boost to students demonstrating exceptional academic merit.
sourceName: Hotcourses Canada Computer and Mathematical Sciences Scholarships

name: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
funding: Up to CAD 40,000 (payable over four years)
academicRequirements: Students must demonstrate exceptional academic achievement and high intellectual promise. Applicants must be entering UBC directly from secondary school.

other: Must meet the UBC English Language Admission Standard.

otherRequirements: Must be an international student who will be studying at UBC on a Canadian study permit (student visa). Must demonstrate outstanding extracurricular and community involvement. Candidates are considered automatically after applying to UBC by the deadline.
description: The IMES is a prestigious award for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programs at UBC. It is renewable for up to three additional years of study provided the student maintains high academic standing.
sourceName: Hotcourses Canada Computer and Mathematical Sciences Scholarships

name: Ontario Graduate Scholarship (OGS)
academicRequirements: Students must have achieved a first-class average (typically A- or 80%) in each of the last two years of full-time study.
otherRequirements: Open to both domestic and international students with a valid study permit. Recipients must be enrolled in a full-time graduate program at a participating Ontario university. The award is for one year (two or three consecutive terms) and is not automatically renewable.
description: Funded by the Province of Ontario and the host university, the OGS encourages excellence in graduate studies at the master’s and doctoral levels. It is a merit-based scholarship available for international students across all disciplines, including mathematics and computer science.
sourceName: Hotcourses Canada Computer and Mathematical Sciences Scholarships

name: The Denys Holland Scholarship
funding: £9,000 per year for three years, subject to satisfactory academic progress.
academicRequirements: Applicants should have a valid UCL Student Number or UCAS Application Number. The scholarship is subject to satisfactory academic progress.
otherRequirements: Applicants must: hold a valid UCL Student Number; hold a valid UCAS Application Number (not a UCAS Personal ID); hold an offer of admission to UCL for full-time undergraduate study in any department; be in financial need, and be able to demonstrate that without the scholarship they would be unable to study at UCL; preferably be aged 25 or under at the time of commencing their studies; and be able to demonstrate that they have broad interests and intend to be actively involved in and contribute to the life of the university.
description: This scholarship aims to support undergraduate students from any country who can demonstrate financial need. It is specifically intended for individuals who have a strong desire to help others and contribute to the university community through extracurricular activities.

name: Birmingham Global Masters Scholarship
academicRequirements: Have received an offer and be selected as the academic best students in their graduating year. Have a valid application ID. Be classifiable as 'domiciled' in one of the eligible countries.
otherRequirements: Be classed by the University as an overseas fee payer for tuition fee purposes. Be starting their studies at the University in September/October 2024 on a full-time on-campus Masters course. Be self-funding and have sufficient funds to cover the full cost of living at the University of Birmingham, plus any visa/travel expenses. Not be in receipt of a full fee-remission scholarship from any other source.
description: This award is designed to attract high-achieving international students to pursue a Master's degree at the University of Birmingham. The scholarship is awarded as a tuition fee discount to the most academically gifted applicants from specific regions.

name: Cardiff Met International Scholarship
academicRequirements: Students must have been offered a place to study a full-time taught Master’s degree. Applicants must demonstrate strong academic performance in their previous undergraduate studies.

other: Must meet the university's standard English language entry requirements.

otherRequirements: Applicants must be classified as an international student for fee purposes. The scholarship is applicable only for full-time postgraduate taught programs (MA/MSc). Candidates must be self-funding. Students who are sponsored by their government or an employer are not eligible.
description: Cardiff Metropolitan University offers these scholarships to support international students entering postgraduate taught programs. The award is applied as a discount against the first year of tuition fees for successful applicants.

name: International Student Scholarship
academicRequirements: Academic merit is determined by the admissions office based on the evaluation of previous academic transcripts and credentials.
otherRequirements: Must be an international student applying for an undergraduate program. Awarded automatically upon admission based on the student's profile.
description: This scholarship is designed to support high-achieving international students pursuing undergraduate law or pre-law tracks at the University of South Dakota. It provides a significant reduction in tuition costs for qualified applicants.

name: Global Spartan Scholarship
academicRequirements: Students must have a strong academic record from their previous institution and maintain a minimum GPA during their studies at SJSU.
otherRequirements: Open to new international students who demonstrate leadership and community involvement. Must be enrolled in a full-time degree program.
description: The Global Spartan Scholarship recognizes the contributions of international students to the SJSU campus community. It is a competitive award for those entering legal studies and other disciplines.

name: International Excellence Award
academicRequirements: Requires a high school GPA equivalent to a 3.0 on a 4.0 scale for freshman or a 3.0 college GPA for transfer students.
otherRequirements: Must be a non-immigrant international student. The award is renewable provided the student maintains a 3.0 GPA at the university.
description: This award provides substantial financial assistance to international students at the University of North Alabama. It targets students with excellent academic backgrounds who are enrolling in the university's law-related undergraduate programs.

name: Alumni Scholarship
academicRequirements: The page does not specify verbatim academic cut-offs; eligibility is generally tied to the completion of a previous degree at the institution.
otherRequirements: Open to alumni of the International University of Malaya-Wales (IUMW).
description: This scholarship is designed to support former students of IUMW who wish to progress their education by enrolling in an MBA program. It encourages lifelong learning within the university's community.

name: Developing Solutions Scholarship
academicRequirements: Applicants must hold an offer for a full-time Masters degree program (including MBA) at the University of Nottingham Malaysia.
otherRequirements: Open to international students from developing and third-world countries. Candidates must demonstrate how the scholarship will help them contribute to the development of their home country.
description: This prestigious award covers the full tuition fees for high-achieving international students from developing nations. It aims to empower individuals to make a significant impact in their home countries after completing their MBA.

name: Postgraduate Coursework Scholarship
academicRequirements: Applicants must meet the entry requirements for the Master by coursework program (MBA) at the Sarawak campus.
otherRequirements: Available for new students enrolling in postgraduate coursework programs.
description: This scholarship provides a partial fee reduction for students pursuing a postgraduate degree by coursework, including the MBA. It is intended to ease the initial financial burden of higher education for new enrollees.

name: Nanyang President's Graduate Scholarship
funding: Covers full tuition fee; monthly stipend of SG 3,000; up to SG 4,000 conference allowance per financial year; one-time IT allowance of SG 1,500, annual grant of SG 500 for journal subscription or book purchase; thesis preparation allowance
academicRequirements:
You must have an Honours (Highest Distinction) or equivalent at Bachelor's level
If you have not yet completed your undergraduate degree programme, you will need to furnish documentation from your university that you are on track to get a Honours (Highest Distinction) degree or equivalent
otherRequirements:
There is no restriction as to the nationality of candidates but all things being equal, preference will be given to Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents.

Scholarships will be awarded to meritorious candidates in each class whose background, work experience, achievements and personal profile contribute to the breadth and depth of ‘diversity’ at the school. There will be balanced considerations of both merit and financial needs.

name: Oxford-Indira Gandhi Graduate Scholarships
funding: The scholarship covers course fees and a grant for living costs of at least £19,237.
academicRequirements: You must be applying to start a new DPhil course at Oxford. You must be applying for one of the eligible courses within the following areas: MSc Biodiversity, Conservation and Management; MSc Economics for Development; MSc Environmental Change and Management; MSc Nature, Society and Environmental Governance; MSc Water Science, Policy and Management; MFE Financial Economics; DPhil Biology; DPhil Earth Sciences; DPhil Economics; DPhil Education; DPhil Engineering Science; DPhil Geography and the Environment; DPhil International Development; DPhil Law; DPhil Management; DPhil Politics; DPhil Public Policy; DPhil Social Policy.
otherRequirements: You must be ordinarily resident in India. You should be intending to return to India once your course is completed. You must be applying to start a new full-time DPhil course. Candidates will be assessed on the basis of their application for graduate study, with a focus on their potential to lead and their commitment to the development of India. If you are offered the scholarship, you will be required to transfer to Somerville College.
description: These scholarships were established by the Government of India and the University of Oxford to support Indian students pursuing research degrees in fields relevant to India’s sustainable development. Successful candidates are expected to return to India to contribute to its growth and development after their studies.

name: Jardine-Oxford Graduate Scholarships
organization: University of Oxford (Exeter, Oriel, Queen's, or Trinity College)
funding: 100% of course fees and a grant for living costs (at least £19,237).
academicRequirements: You must be applying to start a new full-time master's or DPhil course.
otherRequirements: You must be a national of and ordinarily resident in one of the following countries in which Jardine Matheson Group has significant business interests: Cambodia, China, Hong Kong, Indonesia, Malaysia, Myanmar, the Philippines, Singapore, Taiwan, Thailand or Vietnam. In most cases, you must have completed your first degree from a university in one of these countries. You must apply for a course at one of the following four colleges: Exeter College, Oriel College, Queen’s College or Trinity College. Scholarships are awarded on the basis of academic merit, leadership potential and the potential to contribute to the community.
description: A partnership between the Jardine Foundation and the University of Oxford, this scholarship supports outstanding graduate students from specific Asian countries. It is restricted to four specific colleges and looks for candidates with high academic achievement and leadership qualities.

name: Oxford-Hackney Graduate Scholarships
funding: The scholarship covers course fees and a grant for living costs of at least £19,237.
academicRequirements: You must be applying to start a new full-time master's course in the Humanities Division.
otherRequirements: You must be ordinarily resident in the United Kingdom and have attended a state-funded school in the London Borough of Hackney for at least three years of your secondary education. You must be applying to start a new full-time master's course at Wadham College. If you are offered the scholarship, you will be required to transfer to Wadham College.
description: This scholarship is aimed at supporting graduate students from the London Borough of Hackney who are pursuing Master's degrees in the Humanities at Wadham College. It reflects Oxford's commitment to local outreach and socioeconomic diversity within the UK.
